newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds leads sector up amid bear squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds leads sector up amid bear squeeze.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds TSB Group led the bank sector higher amid what traders characterised as a "technical squeeze."
By 1049 GMT, Lloyds shares were up 10p to 468, having reached a all-time peak at 472 earlier. They were among the most actively traded shares in London.

Elsewhere, shares in Abbey National climbed 14p to 787-1/2, just 1/2p off the record high set earlier. Shares in Standard Chartered Bank added 11-1/2p to 705p, while shares in Barclays firmed 3p to 1085, having reached a record peak at 1088 earlier.
The sector outperformed the broad market through 1996 and are expected to continue higher in the near term, they said.
"Market makers are short and those who tried to pick a top got caught," said one market maker.
